**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/01/13 (Fri) 02:20
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Scene where MK, Mei, and Macaque are sitting around a campfire, discussing their next move when they hear rustling in the bushes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A dark-haired monkey bursts into the clearing, panting heavily, and addresses Macaque as "Your Majesty."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The dark-haired monkey informs Macaque that Wukong is scouring the mountain for him and is killing and torturing dark-haired monkeys.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wukong is demanding to know where "the demon that calls itself king" and "my imbecile son" are hiding.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque's face turns stony as he asks how many have been killed.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The dark-haired monkey replies, "Too many, Your Majesty," and explains that Wukong is getting desperate.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mei comforts MK and insists they have to do something to stop Wukong from killing innocent monkeys.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque agrees and states they need to come up with a plan and move to a new location.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK feels a sense of determination and realizes he must step up to stop his father.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Scene where Wukong is scouring the mountain, killing and torturing dark-haired monkeys, demanding information about Macaque and MK.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wukong interrogates a group of dark-haired monkeys, threatening them with violence if they do not reveal the location of Macaque and MK.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wukong uses his fire magic on the monkeys, causing them to scream in agony.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wukong rationalizes his actions as necessary for the greater good of his kingdom.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Scene where MK is in the jungle collecting fruit and hears shouting, leading him to discover Wukong interrogating dark-haired monkeys.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK sees Wukong demanding to know where "the demon that calls itself king" and "my imbecile son" are hiding.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK calls out to Wukong, pleading for him to stop the interrogation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wukong orders his guards to seize MK, who then turns and runs into the jungle to escape.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK reflects on the sight of the dark-haired monkeys and feels the need to help them, despite not knowing how.
